summary: The first-time experience is mostly smooth with clear lane-switching and jumping tutorials, but high-speed crashes feel unresponsive when late swipes fail to register. Additionally, the Game Over end card fades in with low-contrast text and no immediately visible call-to-action, leaving the player briefly unsure of what to do.

items.title: Low-contrast Game Over screen with missing initial CTA
items.evidence: At t=23.4s, the end card appeared (S7) but the decider rated only 32% confidence that a first-time player knows what to do (S2). In the screenshot, 'GAME OVER' is very faint inside the sun and no 'Play now' button is visible yet.
items.suggestion: Increase the contrast and opacity of the 'GAME OVER' header on the end card, and display the 'Play now' CTA button immediately without a fade-in delay.

items.title: Late swipes fail to register before high-speed collisions
items.evidence: At t=15.7s (S3, S5) and t=23.4s (S4), the player's swipe input had no visible effect right before crashing into a pink block, particularly at high speed (SPD 81 at 273m).
items.suggestion: Add input buffering and slightly faster lane-switch interpolation at higher speeds (SPD 60+) so late-frame dodges still register cleanly.

items.title: 2.0s delay before first swipe visibly works
items.evidence: From t=0.0s to t=2.0s (S1), it took 2.0s for the player's first input to visibly move the car despite the 'Swipe to switch lanes!' prompt and hand icon being on screen.
items.suggestion: Enable swipe detection immediately from the first playable frame (t=0.0s) so the player can switch lanes without waiting for any intro lock.
